default.notes: Not on the visa-exemption list — a visitor visa must be obtained before travel from the Immigration Division in Honiara or a Solomon Islands mission; apply well in advance, as there are few overseas posts.

groups.notes: Visa exemption for EU, EEA and Swiss passports — up to 90 days within any 180-day period, granted on arrival.
A free visitor's permit is issued on arrival, normally for 30 days and extendable — but total time in Solomon Islands may not exceed 90 days within any 12-month period.
Visa exemption for up to 30 days. Hong Kong SAR passports were added to the exemption list in August 2026 — confirm with the Immigration Division before booking.

SB.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for citizens of Solomon Islands.

IL.notes: Israeli passport holders are visa-exempt for up to 90 days within any 6-month period.

AE.notes: Emirati passport holders are visa-exempt for up to 90 days under a bilateral exemption agreement.

TW.notes: Taiwan's free visitor-permit arrangement with Solomon Islands ended in April 2025 — Taiwanese passport holders now need a visa issued before travel.
